'''Pseudomotion''', the term referred to the seeming dramatic acceleration of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upon entering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The equivalent phenomenon was observed upon re-entering [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] in the form of massive apparent deceleration. It is not understood if this is an illusion, as relativistic travel faster than the speed of light is impossible, or an effect of the dimensional transition from hyperspace to realspace.<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
